title: ( PAGE IN CONSTRUCTION ) Growth, Inflation, Labor & Market Response
summary: Evolving macro landscape across growth, inflation, labor momentum, USD dynamics, and precious-metals response into year-end.

rows.title: Growth & Inflation — Manufacturing Softens While Prices Stay Sensitive
rows.story: ISM manufacturing remains weak while demand indicators soften and prices stay firm. A cooling goods sector paired with sticky cost dynamics signals a late-cycle mix: growth losing momentum but inflation pressure slowing rather than breaking.

rows.title: Dollar Dynamics — Softer USD Begins Filtering Into Prices
rows.story: A weaker USD is beginning to show up in import-price stabilization and modest upside pressure on traded-goods inflation. Even without a broad inflation reacceleration, currency sensitivity is rising into early 2026 as rate spreads narrow.

rows.title: Labor & Market Behavior — Hiring Slows as Gold Strengthens
rows.story: Labor momentum cooled as ADP signaled weaker private-sector hiring, while market pricing turned toward measured easing. Gold continues to benefit from softer yields, rising cut odds, and a supportive macro-hedge backdrop.
